content:
ARG MAINTAINER="CDSHOP-ECOM"
ARG APPNAME="CDSHOP-ECOM-PAYMENTSERVICE-CUSTOMER-API"
FROM eclipse-temurin:25-jdk-alpine as runtime
ARG MAINTAINER
ARG APPNAME
ARG JAR_FILE=*.jar
RUN mkdir -p /volvocars/apps
COPY ${JAR_FILE} /volvocars/apps/app.jar
EXPOSE 8080
LABEL maintainer=$MAINTAINER \
        app.name=$APPNAME

WORKDIR /volvocars/apps

RUN addgroup --gid 1005 apprunner
RUN adduser -D --uid 1005 apprunner -G apprunner
RUN chown -R apprunner:apprunner /volvocars/apps
USER 1005:1005
RUN ["touch", "/tmp/healthy"]
CMD java ${JAVA_OPTS} -jar app.jar $@

logging:
  level:
    com:
      volvocars:
        ecom: DEBUG

deployment:
  environment: "dev"

spring:
  config:
    import: "configserver:${SPRING_CLOUD_CONFIG_URI}"
  cache:
    type: redis
  data:
    redis:
      host: ps-redis-service
      port: 6379
      password: ${REDIS_PASSWORD}

distributed-locking:
  redis:
    password: ${REDIS_PASSWORD}
    single:
      node: "redis://ps-redis-service:6379"

app-config:
  settings:
    title: VCC \ CD \ Sample API, EU-TEST

deployment:
  region: "weu"

otel:
  resource:
    attributes:
      "deployment.environment": ecp-dev-euwest1

app-config:
  settings:
    title: VCC \ CD \ Sample API, EU

deployment:
  region: "weu"

otel:
  resource:
    attributes:
      "deployment.environment": ecp-prod-euwest1

app-config:
  settings:
    title: VCC \ CD \ Sample API, EU-QA


deployment:
  region: "weu"

otel:
  resource:
    attributes:
      "deployment.environment": ecp-prod-euwest1

app-config:
  settings:
    virtual-path: ""
    auth-enabled: true
    server-url : http://localhost:${CUSTOMER_SERVICE_PORT:8082}

logging:
  level:
    com:
      volvocars:
        ecom: DEBUG
    org:
      springframework:
        data:
          mongodb: DEBUG
  config: classpath:log4j2-spring-local.xml

server:
  port: ${CUSTOMER_SERVICE_PORT:8082}
management:
  server:
    port: ${CUSTOMER_SERVICE_MGMT_PORT:8775}

spring:
  config:
    import:
      - configserver:https://ps-int.weu-dev.ecpaz.volvocars.biz/configserver/
  kafka:
    bootstrap-servers: localhost:9092
    security:
      protocol: PLAINTEXT
    producer:
      security:
        protocol: PLAINTEXT
  mongodb:
    uri: ${MONGO_URI_TEST}
  cache:
    redis:
      host: ${REDIS_HOST:localhost}
      port: ${REDIS_PORT:6379}

psp-integration-client:
  endpoint: "http://localhost:${PSP_INTEGRATION_PORT:8083}"
  auth-settings:
    client-secret: ${CUSTOMER_CLIENT_SECRET}
  client-settings:
    connection-timeout: 60

otel:
  resource:
    attributes:
      "deployment.environment": local
  sdk:
    disabled: true

distributed-locking:
  redis:
    single:
      node: "redis://localhost:6379"

logging:
  level:
    root: INFO

springdoc:
  swagger-ui:
    enabled: false

request-log-filter:
  enabled: false

deployment:
  environment: "prod"

spring:
  config:
    import: "configserver:${SPRING_CLOUD_CONFIG_URI}"
  cache:
    type: redis
  data:
    redis:
      password: "${REDIS_PASSWORD}"
      cluster:
        nodes:
          - ps-redis-service:6379

distributed-locking:
  redis:
    password: ${REDIS_PASSWORD}
    cluster:
      nodes:
       - "redis://ps-redis-service:6379"

oauth2:
  providers:
    azure-ad:
      audiences: # optional, list of the allowed JWT audiences. Azure AD provider enforces aud value check.
        - 17159d64-95c4-4157-a271-9c0070ae8326

psp-integration-client:
  loggerLevel: BASIC
  auth-settings:
    client-id: 17159d64-95c4-4157-a271-9c0070ae8326
    client-secret: ""
    resource-id: 5ba011b2-78af-4ed0-8893-e08a7303a9e2

logging:
  level:
    com:
      volvocars:
        ecom: DEBUG

deployment:
  environment: "qa"

spring:
  config:
    import: "configserver:${SPRING_CLOUD_CONFIG_URI}"
  cache:
    type: redis
  data:
    redis:
      password: "${REDIS_PASSWORD}"
      cluster:
        nodes:
          - ps-redis-service:6379

distributed-locking:
  redis:
    password: "${REDIS_PASSWORD}"
    cluster:
      nodes:
        - "redis://ps-redis-service:6379"

server:
  port: 8080

spring:
  application:
    name: "cds-paymentservice-customer-api"
    version: '@project.version@'
  cloud:
    config:
      name: ps-config
      fail-fast: true
      username: payments
      password: ${SPRING_CLOUD_CONFIG_PASSWORD}
  mongodb:
    uri: mongodb://
    database: payment_services
  data:
    mongodb:
      auto-index-creation: false
  cache:
    type: redis
    cache-names: idempotency-response-cache
    redis:
      key-prefix: cds-paymentservice-customer
      time-to-live: 86400s

psp-integration-client:
  endpoint: "http://ps-psp-integration-api-service:8080"
  loggerLevel: FULL
  auth-settings:
    client-id: cf5bf00f-a730-47c3-a3d8-452f954b227b
    client-secret: ""
    resource-id: 80b50fc2-c3b8-447f-830f-e27ba2cac1cb
    authority: "https://login.microsoftonline.com/81fa766e-a349-4867-8bf4-ab35e250a08f"

logging:
  level:
    root: INFO # this log level setting overrides the default log level setting in the log4j2.xml

request-log-filter:
  enabled: true
  include-request-body-in-debug: true
  include-response-body-in-debug: true
  include-response-body-on-error: true
  max-payload-length: 10000
  include-url-patterns: /v1/*

management:
  server:
    port: 8779
  endpoints:
    web:
      exposure:
        include: "health,prometheus"
    access:
      default: read_only
  endpoint:
    health:
      access: read_only
      probes:
        enabled: true
      group:
        readiness:
          exclude: redis
        liveness:
          exclude: redis
    prometheus:
      access: read_only
  metrics:
    distribution:
      percentiles-histogram:
        http.server.requests: true

otel:
  metric:
    export:
      interval: 60s
  traces:
    exporter: otlp
  metrics:
    exporter: otlp
  logs:
    exporter: none
  exporter:
    otlp:
      endpoint: http://observability-receiver.observability.svc.cluster.local:4318
  propagators:
    - tracecontext
    - baggage

springdoc:
  version: '@springdoc.version@'
  show-actuator: false
  api-docs:
    version: OPENAPI_3_0
  swagger-ui:
    path: "/swagger-ui.html"
    enabled: true
    config-url: "${app-config.settings.virtual-path}/v1/configurations/swagger-config"
    oauth2-redirect-url: ""
    url: "${app-config.settings.virtual-path}${spring.api-docs.path:/v3/api-docs}"

app-config:
  settings:
    virtual-path: "/customer"
    auth-enabled: true
    contact-name : VCC \ CD-POP-PARA
    contact-email : cld-pop-para@grp.volvocars.com
    contact-url : https://devportal.api.volvocars.net
    description : Payment Service Customer API for E-Commerce use cases, part of the Volvo Cars Commerce (VCC) platform.
    title : VCC \ CD \ PaymentService Customer API
    version: 1.0.0
    csrf-disabled: true
    server-url : ${SERVER_URL:http://localhost:8080}
    common-exception-handler-enabled: false

oauth2:
  providers:
    azure-ad:
      issuer: https://sts.windows.net/81fa766e-a349-4867-8bf4-ab35e250a08f/
      jwks-url: https://login.microsoftonline.com/common/discovery/v2.0/keys
      audiences: # optional, list of the allowed JWT audiences. Azure AD provider enforces aud value check.
        - cf5bf00f-a730-47c3-a3d8-452f954b227b
      allowed-types: # optional, list of the allowed JWT  object types. Azure AD provider enforces typ value check.
        - JWT

distributed-locking:
  engine: redis
  wait-time-ms: 10000
  lease-time-ms: 40000
  fault-tolerant: true

<Configuration status="trace">
    <Properties>
        <Property name="appName">$${spring:spring.application.name}</Property>
    </Properties>
    <Appenders>
        <Console name="LogToConsole" target="SYSTEM_OUT">
            <PatternLayout pattern="%date{yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss.SSS} %highlight{${LOG_LEVEL_PATTERN:-%5level}}{FATAL=red blink, ERROR=red, WARN=yellow bold, INFO=green, DEBUG=green bold, TRACE=blue} [%threadName] %style{%class}{cyan} Method: %style{%method}{Magenta} Line: %style{%line}{green}  %style{%message}  %rException{full}%n"  disableAnsi="false"/>
        </Console>
    </Appenders>
    <Loggers>
        <Root level="ALL">
            <AppenderRef ref="LogToConsole"/>
        </Root>
    </Loggers>
</Configuration>

<Configuration status="trace">
    <Properties>
        <Property name="appName">$${spring:spring.application.name}</Property>
    </Properties>
    <Appenders>
        <Console name="LogToConsole" target="SYSTEM_OUT">
            <EcsLayout>
                <KeyValuePair key="level" value="%level"/>
                <KeyValuePair key="service.name" value="$${spring:spring.application.name:-}" />
                <KeyValuePair key="service.environment" value="$${spring:deployment.environment:-}" />
                <KeyValuePair key="service.region" value="$${spring:deployment.region:-}" />
                <KeyValuePair key="service.version" value="$${spring:spring.application.version:-}" />
                <!--
                Available values from ctx come from ThreadContext. The ones below are specified in
                com.volvocars.ecom.web.filter.OperationIdFilter.

                They are already automatically added to logs as their own fields, the lines below
                serve just to be more consistent with other Elasticsearch fields and make it easier
                to query.
                 -->
                <KeyValuePair key="url.path" value="$${ctx:requestPath:-}"/>
                <KeyValuePair key="http.request.method" value="$${ctx:method:-}"/>
                <KeyValuePair key="http.response.status_code" value="$${ctx:responseStatus:0}"/>
            </EcsLayout>
        </Console>
    </Appenders>
    <Loggers>
        <Root level="ALL">
            <AppenderRef ref="LogToConsole"/>
        </Root>
    </Loggers>
</Configuration>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<project xmlns="http://maven.apache.org/POM/4.0.0"
         xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
         xsi:schemaLocation="http://maven.apache.org/POM/4.0.0 http://maven.apache.org/xsd/maven-4.0.0.xsd">
    <modelVersion>4.0.0</modelVersion>
    <parent>
        <groupId>com.volvocars.ecom</groupId>
        <artifactId>cds-paymentservice-customer</artifactId>
        <version>1.0.34-SNAPSHOT</version>
    </parent>

    <artifactId>cds-paymentservice-customer-client</artifactId>

    <properties>
        <skip.deploy>false</skip.deploy>
        <sonar.skip>true</sonar.skip>
    </properties>

    <dependencies>
        <dependency>
            <groupId>com.volvocars.services</groupId>
            <artifactId>cds-volvocars-shared-utility</artifactId>
        </dependency>
        <dependency>
            <groupId>com.volvocars.ecom</groupId>
            <artifactId>cds-paymentservice-customer-shared</artifactId>
            <version>${project.version}</version>
        </dependency>
        <dependency>
            <groupId>com.volvocars.ecom</groupId>
            <artifactId>cds-paymentservice-feign</artifactId>
            <scope>compile</scope>
        </dependency>

        <!-- Test dependencies for unit tests copied from integration behavior -->
        <!-- Align JUnit platform / Jupiter versions with the rest of the multi-module project (Spring Boot 4 uses JUnit 6 series)
             Use JUnit Jupiter 6.x to avoid junit-platform commons version conflicts during test discovery. -->
        <dependency>
            <groupId>org.junit.jupiter</groupId>
            <artifactId>junit-jupiter-api</artifactId>
            <scope>test</scope>
        </dependency>
        <dependency>
            <groupId>org.junit.jupiter</groupId>
            <artifactId>junit-jupiter-engine</artifactId>
            <scope>test</scope>
        </dependency>
        <dependency>
            <groupId>org.mockito</groupId>
            <artifactId>mockito-core</artifactId>
            <scope>test</scope>
        </dependency>
        <dependency>
            <groupId>org.assertj</groupId>
            <artifactId>assertj-core</artifactId>
            <scope>test</scope>
        </dependency>
    </dependencies>

</project>

services:
  redis:
    image: redis:8.8.0-alpine
    container_name: cds-paymentservice-customer-redis
    ports:
      - "6379:6379"
    command: ["redis-server", "--save", "60", "1", "--loglevel", "warning"]
    volumes:
      - redis_data:/data
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "redis-cli", "ping"]
      interval: 10s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 5

  redisinsight:
    image: redis/redisinsight:latest
    container_name: cds-paymentservice-customer-redisinsight
    depends_on:
      redis:
        condition: service_healthy
    ports:
      - "5540:5540"
    environment:
      RI_REDIS_HOST0: redis
      RI_REDIS_PORT0: 6379
      RI_REDIS_ALIAS0: cds-paymentservice-customer-redis
    volumes:
      - redisinsight_data:/data

volumes:
  redis_data:
  redisinsight_data:

lombok.toString.onlyExplicitlyIncluded = true
lombok.sneakyThrows.flagUsage = error
lombok.log.slf4j.flagUsage = error
lombok.log.xslf4j.flagUsage = error
lombok.accessors.chain = true
lombok.data.flagUsage = error

lombok.copyableAnnotations += org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Qualifier
lombok.copyableAnnotations += org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Value
